notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two searches and a few reads found only the statewide tnlandforms list (Overton County, 1,962 ft, removed). Search results mention Overton County's Twinton tower (1933, CCC-era) and Pilot tower, but not Seahorn, so they are not used. Nothing found gives a build date, builder, staffing, fires, or what remains today. The NRHP study covers the state network; no source found ties Seahorn to it, so the story keeps that context statewide. Record registers lists NGS (state_number GB 2386). As with Russell Field, the tnlandforms code looks like a survey designation rather than a lookout register; the cached NHLR Tennessee list does not name Seahorn. Consider removing NGS from registers. Record elevation_m 598.0 matches 1,962 ft. Record status gone matches removed.
